architecture_decisions.primary_extension: full browser-agent capability; no reduced Core/Advanced split
architecture_decisions.permissions: Kimi-class capability envelope accepted when it maps to real BrowserCrew functionality
architecture_decisions.trusted_input: primary runtime escalation layer after ordinary DOM tools
architecture_decisions.raw_cdp: authenticated final escape hatch through built-in agent and Local Bridge
architecture_decisions.continued_advantage: preserve BrowserCrew provider neutrality, Primary/Fallback routing, approvals, deterministic tests, task sessions, Local Bridge and Skill evaluation on top of the full browser-control substrate

next_action: Implement Site -> Skill v1 as a usable vertical slice from fresh AX/evaluate/network evidence into a candidate executable Skill recipe with inferred parameters, provenance, verification evidence and a hard safety boundary. Keep SK-BROWSER-001 cross-runtime evaluation as a parallel external-runtime blocker and never fabricate it.
